provider: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS)
physicalCaveats: Both instruments measure water level far from Grand Marais; they do not measure waterline height, wave runup or flooded beach access at Agate Beach.
Wind setup and Lake Superior seiches can redistribute water after waves ease and create geographically different fluctuations.
Preliminary values have NOAA quality flag q=p; verified values q=v. Rate, flat and range flags invalidate an observation here.
One isolated NOAA gauge fluctuation cannot be interpreted as exact height or timing of exposed gravel at the pilot shoreline.
rightsOrUse: Public NOAA observations; original timestamp and source preserved; no API key or per-visitor external requests.
